description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Safehold Elite.
When Safehold Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Safehold Elite.
When Safehold Elite dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
